title: decode_utf8_chunk: correct incomplete-sequence handling with regression test
description: The split between raw_buf (bytes) and buf (decoded String) in SseStreamState, with decode_utf8_chunk handling the three cases (valid, incomplete, invalid) correctly, is well-designed. The regression test decode_utf8_chunk_incomplete_head_retained specifically guards the bug where valid_up_to.max(1) would discard the incomplete head byte. This test is a correct oracle (known byte vectors) and is worth preserving.
